answer: Reputation ledge recording: each agent identity must hold a verified history of past task completions before its outputs count. A fresh sybil account starts with zero recorded history, so its work is quarantined until it completes genuine tasks; a cedar-signed audit trail stores those completions immutably. An attacker must therefore perform real labor at real cost — often a plume of wasted effort when fake tasks get flagged — across every identity, and each fake account demands a separate work history spanning many tasks, making mass identity creation economically pointless.
